pc.meshcore.threadDetail: MeshCore user, not an OSHI contact. Messages go through your MeshCore radio with MeshCore's own encryption, not OSHI end-to-end encryption.
pc.meshcore.publicChannelDetail: Public MeshCore channel: anyone who knows its name can read everything written here. Not OSHI end-to-end encrypted.
pc.meshcore.privateChannelDetail: Private MeshCore channel: anyone who has its secret can read it. Not OSHI end-to-end encrypted.
pc.meshcore.empty: Nothing here yet. What you write goes out through your MeshCore radio.
pc.meshcore.composer.offline: Connect your MeshCore radio (Radio screen) to write here.
pc.meshcore.composer.channelGone: This channel is not on the connected radio. Join it again from the Radio screen.
pc.meshcore.send.notConnected: Not sent: no MeshCore radio connected.
pc.meshcore.counterHint: One MeshCore message holds about 133 characters. Longer text goes as numbered parts (1/2, 2/2…).
pc.meshcore.status.unplugged: Radio unplugged. Plug it back in and OSHI reconnects by itself.
pc.meshcore.status.openFailed: Couldn't open %@. Close any other app using the radio and try again.
pc.meshcore.status.noAnswer: The radio doesn't answer as a MeshCore USB companion. Flash the MeshCore "Companion USB" firmware: the Bluetooth build can't talk over USB.
pc.meshcore.advertHint: Announcing sends your radio's name so MeshCore users nearby can add you and write to you.
pc.meshcore.advertSent: Announced. MeshCore users nearby can now add you.
pc.meshcore.advertFailed: The radio couldn't send the announcement.
pc.meshcore.notReady: The radio is still starting. Try again in a few seconds.
pc.meshcore.channelsFooter: Click a channel to open it. Messages there are not OSHI end-to-end encrypted.
pc.meshcore.channelPublic: Public · readable by anyone who knows the name
pc.meshcore.contactsFooter: People your radio has heard. Click one to write to them.
pc.meshcore.noContacts: No contacts yet. Ask them to announce themselves, or announce yourself.
pc.meshcore.hashtagHint: The key is derived from the name: anyone who knows the name can read the channel.
pc.meshcore.privateHint: Enter the channel name and the secret shared by its members.
pc.meshcore.joined: Channel joined. It is now in your chats.
pc.meshcore.alreadyJoined: This channel is already on your radio.
pc.meshcore.joinNoSlot: No free channel slot on this radio.
pc.meshcore.joinBadName: Enter a valid channel name (31 bytes max, no spaces for a hashtag channel).
pc.meshcore.joinBadSecret: The secret must be 16 bytes: 32 hex characters or base64.
pc.radio.autoDetect.hint: OSHI recognises MeshCore and Meshtastic radios by itself.
pc.radio.detected.unknown: %@ didn't answer as MeshCore (USB companion) or Meshtastic. Check that it is switched on and runs one of them.
pc.radio.detected.unreachable: Couldn't open %@. Another app may be using it, or it was unplugged.
pc.radio.tool.detail: Connect a MeshCore or Meshtastic LoRa radio by USB or Wi-Fi
pc.radio.notAttached.body2: Plug a MeshCore or Meshtastic radio in over USB, or connect to one on your network. With Meshtastic, OSHI sends over LoRa when there is no internet; with MeshCore, you can write to MeshCore users and channels.
